cluster_assignment_rule: Connected components sharing any cluster key cannot span partitions
sire_rule: Record identity or authenticated unavailable status and assess pedigree covariance before independence claims
repeated_litter_rule: Same dam remains one grouped split unit even across litters or batches
sampling_adequacy_rule: Physical timing/resolution must resolve selected constitutive and transport timescales or independently bound them; review records required
initial_condition_rule: Only pre-cutoff observations and permitted independent physical measurements; no hidden-outcome geometry

specimen_condition_bindings.treatment_record_rule: Record binds embryo identity, genotype, control/intervention, time course and source revision; reviewed contents must agree with declared condition. Batch identity cannot substitute.
specimen_condition_bindings.holdout_rule: Each admitted condition must match the separately frozen intervention mapping and scope review; UNRESOLVED is never sufficient for admission.
